subject.title: feat: add Computer Use plugin manifest contract

question: Should OpenClaw publish this metadata-only Computer Use manifest contract, and should maintainers use the rebased PR as the landing path instead of this dirty draft branch?
rationale: The change is additive, but it freezes public plugin API surface and is intended to inform host decisions around Accessibility and Screen Recording permissions; automation cannot choose that security boundary or branch strategy.

options.title: Use the rebased contract PR
options.body: Continue review on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101564 or an equivalent fresh rebase, refresh generated docs, and confirm discovery-only semantics before landing.

options.title: Repair this draft branch
options.body: Ask the author to rebase this PR, refresh `docs/docs_map.md`, and keep this branch as the landing candidate after owner confirmation.

options.title: Pause the public contract
options.body: Keep the work draft or close the branch until the macOS host binding model is settled enough to publish plugin API surface.

recommendation.title: Use the rebased contract PR
recommendation.body: Continue review on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101564 or an equivalent fresh rebase, refresh generated docs, and confirm discovery-only semantics before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history on the manifest/docs surface and authored the rebased Computer Use contract branch now stacked under the runtime work.
